text:
maya: Hey infra — I'm opening a quick check: I pushed a small TF change that moves per-model feature flags from a ConfigMap to a Secret for the 'safety' model group. Goal is to restrict visibility and let Kustomize overlay the secret per-env. Patch link: https://git.company/redwood/infra/commit/abcd123

maya: TF diff creates a k8s_secret resource and removes the configmap, but I'm worried about the rolling update behavior. Current app watches ConfigMap checksum annotation to reload. We need to replicate that with the Secret.

jon: :eyes: can you paste the k8s manifest snippet you expect the app to read? Also does the runtime have secret-watcher capability or only configmap-watcher?

maya: manifest is basically
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: inference-service
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        config.redwood.com/config-checksum: "${checksum}"
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: server
        env:
        - name: SAFETY_FLAGS
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: safety-flags
              key: flags.json
```
We currently rely on the checksum annotation being set by k8s template via terraform/helm. The app side only listens for annotation changes (not secrets directly).

lee: Okay — two step options:
1) Keep the annotation approach and compute checksum from the secret content in TF/CI, set annotation on Deployment like you showed. That triggers rollout.
2) Add a small sidecar secret-watcher that updates the annotation when the secret changes (but needs RBAC and extra container). Dev-runtime prefers 1 for now.

sasha: If you go with TF-compute-checksum, make sure the CI pipeline writes the checksum after the secret is rendered. We had a race earlier where secret created after deployment and checksum didn't match => stale pod.

maya: Good call. I updated the TF in the branch to compute sha256 of the rendered secret and add the annotation. See comment on the PR. Also added a note to the kustomize overlay to avoid the ConfigMap being created in prod.

jon: Quick code-review: can you add a short unit test in infra/terraform/modules/k8s that verifies checksum changes when flags.json changes? It can be a tiny harness that runs the same hashing function.

maya: Yep will add. Also pinging @deploy-bot for a heads-up — after we merge runbook says to do a canary rollout to staging then prod.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for inference-service in staging at 2026-03-17T15:30:00Z. Link to pipeline: https://ci.redwood/build/7123 :white_check_mark:

jon: One more check — ensure Dedicated instances (reserved GPU pool) mount the same secret name/namespace. We had a namespace mismatch last time where dedicated pods looked at `infra` ns but secret lived in `global` ns.

maya: Confirmed — TF sets the secret in the runtime namespace used by both hosted and dedicated. Also added a note in the PR description about cross-namespace access.

lee: :thumbsup: If staging canary looks good, I'll approve the TF apply. maya, can you drop a short post-merge checklist in PR so oncall isn't surprised?

maya: Will do. Thanks all. :pray:
